credit_transactions_usage_shape.name: credit_transactions_usage_shape
credit_transactions_usage_shape.value: ("credit_transactions"."kind" = 'usage') = ("credit_transactions"."cost_entry_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("credit_transactions"."kind" <> 'usage' OR ("credit_transactions"."amount_vnd" <= 0 AND "credit_transactions"."reason" IS NULL))

credit_transactions_adjustment_shape.name: credit_transactions_adjustment_shape
credit_transactions_adjustment_shape.value: "credit_transactions"."kind" <> 'adjustment' OR ("credit_transactions"."reason" IS NOT NULL AND "credit_transactions"."note" IS NOT NULL AND "credit_transactions"."amount_vnd" <> 0)

credit_transactions_note_length.name: credit_transactions_note_length
credit_transactions_note_length.value: "credit_transactions"."note" IS NULL OR char_length("credit_transactions"."note") BETWEEN 1 AND 200

model_prices_non_negative.name: model_prices_non_negative
model_prices_non_negative.value: "model_prices"."input_usd_micros_per_mtok" >= 0 AND "model_prices"."output_usd_micros_per_mtok" >= 0 AND "model_prices"."cache_read_usd_micros_per_mtok" >= 0 AND ("model_prices"."cache_write_usd_micros_per_mtok" IS NULL OR "model_prices"."cache_write_usd_micros_per_mtok" >= 0)
